violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 51F AND PLANT BASED MILK AT 52F IN WHIRLPOOL 2 DOOR 1 DRAWER UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED MILK DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WHIRLPOOL 2 DOOR 1 DRAWER UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR/FREEZER AT 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. TCS FOODS WERE DISCARDED. TCS FOODS WILL BE STORED IN 1 DOOR REFRIGERATOR AT 38F IN TODDLER CLASSROOM UNTIL MAIN REFRIGERATOR IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. EMAIL EHS ONCE REFRIGERATOR HAS BEEN REPAIRED.
